# Purchasing

Purchasing manages supplier sourcing and commercial commitments while Inventory remains the only owner of physical receiving and Accounting owns supplier liabilities.

## How to use this module

Start from the module dashboard to understand queues and exceptions, then open the screen that owns the record or action you need. The structure below follows the dashboard module switcher and sidebar.

## Dashboard screens

<div class="module-grid">
<a class="module-card" href="/guide/screens/vendors/dashboard"><strong>Purchasing Dashboard</strong><span>Use the Purchasing Dashboard to review sourcing demand, open supplier commitments, approvals, upcoming deliveries and purchasing attention queues.</span></a>
<a class="module-card" href="/guide/screens/vendors/purchase-needs"><strong>Purchase Needs</strong><span>Review internal demand that requires external purchasing and turn eligible need into RFQ/PO sourcing without losing source provenance.</span></a>

<a class="module-card" href="/guide/screens/vendors/purchase-order"><strong>Purchase Orders</strong><span>Create, approve and send supplier commitments, then follow confirmation, inbound allocation, physical receipt and billing progress.</span></a>

## Ownership rule

Purchasing changes supplier commercial commitments and may create inbound or billing follow-up, but it does not post physical stock.
